Fayrakh

Biography

Fayrakh is a magician of the Last Shelter who sees Zak’s journey as a chance to hurt enemies on the surface. He offers magical aid without disguising his taste for revenge. His work with Kehel can delay his departure, and he ultimately prefers the Shelter to life on Gipath. [1, 2, 3]
